source.from: WorkBench email template "Reply to {name}'s last email about '{subject}'"

request: Reply to the International Office that I'll send the signed signature page by Wednesday 18 November.

mails.subject: Erasmus learning agreement – missing signature page
mails.body:
Dear Tom,

Your Erasmus learning agreement for the spring semester is missing the signed signature page. Please send it to us by Friday 20 November, otherwise your application cannot be forwarded to the partner university.

Kind regards,
International Office
